International Energy Agency (2026). Methane abatement model - cost calculation (open-source code and assumption files: redtechGuide.csv, LDARGuide.csv, parameters.csv, j_4_1_cost_calc.py). GitLab: https://gitlab.com/iea-public/methane/abatement-model/cost-calculation (branch master), accessed 2026-10-07. Paris: IEA.

Held documents: iea_2026_methane-abatement-model-redtechguide-data.csv and -ldarguide-data.csv (semicolon-separated, transcribed by the coordinator from the GitLab repository via browser on 2026-10-07; gitlab is blocked from the shells) and -notes.txt (README column definitions, parameters.csv values, cost-calculation logic). Loaded: 46 reduction technologies from redtechGuide (50 rows; the Incomplete-flare duplicates of Microturbine, Mini-LNG and Mini-CNG are identical to the Vented rows and were not repeated; Install automated air-fuel ratio controls kept under both reasons because it maps to engines (Vented, category Other) and flares (Incomplete-flare)) and 20 LDARGuide rows (5 LDAR frequencies x segment, plus abandoned-well monitoring for 2 sectors). Per technology: capex (base_capital, USD per system), opex-fixed (base_operating, USD per system-year), lifetime (project_life_years), emissions-reduction-potential (reduction_ratio x 100), capacity as recoverable gas (reduction_volume_kt, kt natural gas per system-year) and as t CH4/yr = kt x 1000 x ch4 ratio (0.83 ch4_at_well_ratio for upstream, 0.98 ch4_in_pipeline_ratio for the three pipeline options: temporary mobile/inline compression, pipeline pump-down, blowdown/ESD redesign; the guide has no segment column so the segment is the extractor's assignment), and derived capex and opex per t CH4/yr abated (formula column). LDAR: capex = Base Capital per site, opex-fixed = Base Labour per site (taken as annual), site emissions taken as kt CH4 (README does not say gas or CH4); per-t values = cost / (site emissions x reduction ratio x 1000). Travel time, hours to fix, working hours, training hours and contractor fee in _other-values with the three model-wide parameters (discount rate 0.08). PRICE YEAR: not printed anywhere in the model; 2025_USD adopted by inference from the GMT 2026 Documentation (2025 gas, electricity and coal prices; Bloomberg 2024 import data) - flag for review. Many base_capital values are exactly 1.37 x round EPA Natural Gas STAR figures (27,400 = 20,000 x 1.37; 41,100; 68,500; 4,110), i.e. a single escalation of older EPA costs; the escalation base year is not stated. Values are US base values before the model's country capital/labour/tariff scalers and the oil-source infrastructure scalar. Float artefacts in the files (e.g. 27400.000000000004) rounded to 10 significant figures. Traps: (1) the Incomplete-flare rows for Install Vapor Recovery Units and its challenging-settings variant carry each other's Vented values (swapped). (2) Improve flaring-Portable Completions Workovers WO HF and -Portable WO Plunger Lifts have base_operating 821,418 per year; with 0.00087 kt per system the per-t values are extreme (suspect). (3) Replace with Electric Heater has the same numbers as Replace with Electric Motor - challenging settings. (4) Improve-flaring and route-to-flare options have is_gas_salable False (no gas revenue). (5) Mechanical Pumping for Liquids Unloading is listed in Documentation Table 8 but not in redtechGuide. Locator: file name plus row key (no pages).
